description: All field-of-study programs at one school with median earnings 1 year after the highest credential, cumulative Stafford/Grad PLUS debt, and IPEDS awards for each year of the pooled debt cohort. Institution-level 6/8/10-year earnings are available via scorecard_get_earnings. Null or absent earnings have unknown cause; suppressed=true requires an explicit provider privacy marker. Use scorecard_lookup_cip to find CIP codes by name.

cip_code.description: Filter to one 4-digit CIP code, dotted or undotted (e.g. "11.07" or "1107" for Computer Science). Returns one row per credential level the school offers in that program.

credential_level.description: Filter by credential level: 1=undergraduate certificate, 2=associate, 3=bachelor, 4=post-baccalaureate certificate, 5=master, 6=doctoral, 7=first professional, 8=graduate/professional certificate, 99=non-credential.

anyOf.description: Base-10 school ID resolving to a positive safe integer; whitespace, leading zeros, plus, decimal, and exponent forms are accepted.

name: scorecard_get_programs

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `api_conflict`: The provider reported a request conflict. `api_invalid_params`: Provider rejected a query parameter. `api_validation`: A meaningful selector or provider value is invalid. `api_unauthorized`: The provider rejected the API credentials. `api_forbidden`: The provider denied access. `api_rate_limited`: The provider throttled the request. `api_timeout`: The provider exchange exceeded its deadline. `api_not_found`: The provider endpoint returned HTTP 404. `api_invalid_request`: The provider returned an unexpected redirect. `api_internal`: The provider returned an unclassified HTTP response. `school_not_found`: No school record found for the requested ID. `api_error`: The College Scorecard API returned an error. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when no programs match or some earnings are unavailable or privacy-suppressed.

programs.description: All programs matching the filters, sorted by earnings descending with unavailable or privacy-suppressed earnings last.

earnings_1yr_median.description: Median earnings of graduates working and not enrolled 1 year after their highest credential.

earnings_availability.description: Available number, unavailable with unknown cause, or confirmed privacy suppression.

earnings_count.description: Graduates working and not enrolled 1 year after their highest credential, matching the earnings median population.

ipeds_awards_year1.description: IPEDS awards in year 1 of the pooled debt cohort; awards, not enrollment or unique students.

ipeds_awards_year2.description: IPEDS awards in year 2 of the pooled debt cohort; awards, not enrollment or unique students.

median_debt.description: Median cumulative Stafford/Grad PLUS borrowing among completers across attended institutions at the same academic level.

suppressed.description: True only when the provider explicitly marks earnings as privacy-suppressed.

query.description: Normalized effective school ID and program selectors.

suppressed_count.description: Number of programs with confirmed privacy-suppressed earnings.

unavailable_count.description: Programs with unavailable earnings of unknown cause.

title: Get School Programs
